prompt: Create a crisp, friendly educational water-cycle infographic, landscape layout, flat vector illustration with clean shapes, high contrast, airy light-blue sky, readable typography, professionally composed. Show the water cycle looping across a coastal mountain landscape: sun warms a lake, vapor rises, clouds form, rain falls on mountain, streams flow back to lake. Use only these exact visible labels, each spelled correctly and legibly: “THE WATER CYCLE”, “SUN”, “EVAPORATION”, “CONDENSATION”, “PRECIPITATION”, “COLLECTION”, “RUNOFF”. Place each label in its specified box, with arrows and visual proximity clearly communicating the cycle. No other words or lettering. Keep all content inside the canvas, uncluttered, no overlap.
negativePrompt: misspelled text, extra text, gibberish lettering, illegible labels, overlapping elements, clutter, photorealism, watermark, border, cropped objects

metadata.desc: Pale blue sky background filling the entire canvas, with subtle pale green ground along the lower edge.
Bright warm yellow sun with simple rays in the upper-left sky.
Three soft white-blue clouds gathered in the upper middle, above the mountain.
Green mountain with a snow-capped summit on the right, rainfall and a small stream descending its slope.
Blue lake at bottom center-left, receiving the stream; show gentle ripples.
Large, bold infographic title centered across the top.
Small clear label directly beneath the sun.
Clear process label alongside upward arrows rising from the lake.
Clear process label under the cloud, beside vapor forming into cloud.
Clear process label beside raindrops falling onto the mountain.
Clear process label below the lake.
Clear process label beside the stream flowing downhill.
